objects.name: The Gnawed Door
objects.vInscr: Teeth-marks on the lintel, at the height of a man's throat.

landmarks.name: The Paid Witness
landmarks.inscription: Its priests put out its eyes so it could not see what was done in its name, and paid it for the loss. It is still holding out its hands.

landmarks.name: The Hand That Was Kept
landmarks.inscription: It blessed the first war and was cut off for it. They caged it rather than bury it, lest the earth be blessed as well.
